purpose: Teach: 内的/醸成/顕在/利己/襲う/疑わしい/粉砕/萎縮

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者さんの内的な不安を医療チームで丁寧に汲み取ります
lines.en: Ren — we listen carefully to what patients carry beneath the surface. Our whole team does.
lines.style: Steady, clear-eyed opening. Direct but warm. Measured pace. The confidence of someone speaking her commitment aloud. No defensiveness — just fact.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、安心感を醸成する病棟運営を医療チームで進めます
lines.en: Yes. Building that sense of safety throughout the ward — that's something we work toward as a team.
lines.style: Affirmation without weight. Gentle, measured tone. Slight warmth in the word 'safety.' Professional but not distant. The kind of clarity that comes from having said this before and meaning it still.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 症状が顕在化する前の予防医療を、貴院、重視されてますね、先生
lines.en: So your hospital does emphasize preventive care — catching things before they even emerge. That's remarkable, Doctor.
lines.style: Thoughtful, genuinely curious. Careful articulation — he's assembling the observation as he speaks. Slight rise at the end, checking if he's understood correctly. Respectful but not deferential.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、利己的な医療行為は医療チームで厳禁とします
lines.en: Yes. Self-serving medical practice — that has no place here. Our team is clear on that.
lines.style: Firmer than before. A light edge on 'self-serving' — not angry, but resolute. The kind of statement that closes a door politely but completely. Still warm underneath.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 感染症が患者を襲う前の対策を、貴院、なさってますね、先生
lines.en: And you're already doing preventive work for infections too — before they can reach the patient. Aren't you, Doctor?
lines.style: Curious but building. Slight lift of recognition. He's noticing a pattern. Not questioning — admiring. Respectful pause before 'Doctor,' like he's really asking.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、疑わしい症例は医療チームで二度確認します
lines.en: Yes. With unclear cases, our team checks twice. We don't move on assumption.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact. The certainty of protocol spoken without ceremony. Clear and direct. A slight emphasis on 'twice' — not caution, but care.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 結石を粉砕する内視鏡治療を、貴院、なさってるんですね、先生
lines.en: So you're actually doing endoscopic stone treatment here — breaking them up rather than letting them sit. That's — that takes real skill, Doctor.
lines.style: Genuine curiosity mixed with quiet awe. Slight breath before 'takes real skill' — he's noticing something impressive and saying it simply. Warm, slightly awed. Not flattery — observation.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、長期入院で患者が萎縮しないよう医療チームで配慮します
lines.en: Yes. Long hospital stays can shrink a person — emotionally, psychologically. Our team works to make sure that doesn't happen.
lines.style: Quiet but firm. The weight of having seen what long stays do to people. Warm but not soft. Speaking from observation, not theory. Slight pause before 'doesn't happen' — conviction underneath.
